title: Digital TEI-XML edition of Camillo Porzio's "La congiura de' Baroni del Regno di Napoli contra re Ferdinando primo"
notes: A Zenodo-published TEI-XML dataset of the critical digital edition of Porzio's La congiura de' Baroni (first published Naples 1565), encoded and curated by Cristiano Amendola; matches the Renascor Corpus origin (single text). DOI 10.5281/zenodo.18047915 verified live; license CC BY 4.0. The Renascor Corpus holds the TEI-derived text (~49k words). Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
institution: Cristiano Amendola (KU Leuven), within PRIN 2022 "HISTORIALE MARE" (PI Fulvio Delle Donne, Università di Napoli Federico II)
license_note: The Zenodo record (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.18047915) gives Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International for the TEI-XML files (ara73.zip).
